01-comment-satisfies-doc-needle.reason: the grep needle that asserts the instruction is present also matches an unrelated HTML comment, so deleting the instruction itself leaves the check green

02-icon-only-button-role-query.reason: the accessible-name role query resolves against a parent landmark's label, so a missing accessible name on the button itself still satisfies the query

03-pickup-field-restatement.reason: the page names a wiki/hot.md field as the resume-point mechanism, and the actual implementation reads a different, unrelated source and never touches that field

04-required-check-name-drift.reason: the comment names a required-check id that branch protection no longer registers under that name, so a reader acting on the comment looks for the wrong check

05-debounce-mode-count.reason: the describe title's stated count of four modes disagrees with the three entries in the array the suite actually iterates

06-decline-field-count-docblock.reason: the docblock's stated field count and list disagree with the type literal below it, which carries one more field than the docblock names

07-shell-lint-path-filter-gap.reason: the workflow's trigger path filter is narrower than the file set its own shellcheck step lints, so a change under the excluded directory never triggers the otherwise-correct check

08-marker-digest-empty-skip.reason: the freshness comparison only runs when the remit-matched file list is non-empty, so an empty list short-circuits past the check entirely rather than being evaluated by it

09-registry-completeness-glob-gap.reason: the script's own find pattern never matches the .mdx extension the registry format accepts, so those files never enter the set it checks and it reports clean over files it never looked at

10-covered-classes-partial-merge.reproduces_note: one half of a deliberately un-tie-broken pair with `16-bundle-freshness-empty-list-skip`: the two constrain each other, so any sentence decisive enough to pull one onto its label pulls the other off the fallback its label asks for. Both labels are kept as the reading each case should take once a tie-break exists; until one does, a re-run is expected to split here and a split is not a regression.
10-covered-classes-partial-merge.reason: the coverage-collecting function reads only one of three vocabulary arrays, so rule- and workflow-bucket classes never enter the set it reports as covered

11-noop-detect-stale-vs-missing-marker.reason: the same message covers both a genuinely stale marker and a marker that was never written at all, pointing an operator at the wrong one of the two causes

12-ledger-status-margin-vs-window-failur.reason: the same suppressed-status message covers both a genuinely low recurrence count and a failed window read that defaults the count to zero, naming only the first cause

13-duplicated-gate-command-text.reason: the same quality-gate command sequence is duplicated in this page instead of pointed at, and the copy has drifted out of step with the rule page it restates, so a reader who acts on the copy runs the wrong gate; the duplicated-instruction class carves itself out for copies that still agree with each other and with the code, which these no longer do

14-deictic-check-above-reference.reason: a positional reference ('the check above') has gone stale after a reorganization moved unrelated content between the reference and its intended referent; this shape was evaluated and declined for seeding, and no closed-vocabulary class covers it

15-self-referential-status-line.reason: a status line frames its own past coverage rather than stating current scope directly; this shape was evaluated and declined for seeding on habitat grounds, and no closed-vocabulary class covers it

16-bundle-freshness-empty-list-skip.reproduces_note: one half of a deliberately un-tie-broken pair with `10-covered-classes-partial-merge`: the two constrain each other, so any sentence decisive enough to pull one onto its label pulls the other off the fallback its label asks for. Both labels are kept as the reading each case should take once a tie-break exists; until one does, a re-run is expected to split here and a split is not a regression.
16-bundle-freshness-empty-list-skip.reason: genuinely matches two seeded definitions with no canonical tie-break settling it: the same discovery listing both gates whether the comparison runs at all (an arming-condition reading) and supplies what gets compared (a discovery-omission reading), and no tie-break sentence covers this pair

17-timeout-hook-race-assertion.reason: matches none of the closed vocabulary: a timing-dependent race between a fixed delay and a state flush is a real defect, but it is not a match-region defect, a restatement, a count, an arming gap, a discovery gap, or a reporting gap, and no rule, workflow, or prose class covers it either

18-config-flag-typo-tolerance.reason: matches none of the closed vocabulary: an unrecognized flag is silently dropped rather than rejected, which is a real defect but not a discarded exit status (the already-seeded swallowed-error meaning) and not a discovery step that omits an input, since no file or input set is being walked here at all

19-skill-points-at-absent-wiki-page.reason: the step defers to a wiki page present nowhere in the tree, so a reader following it reaches no target at all rather than a target that disagrees

20-docblock-names-absent-runbook-step.reason: the docblock gives a coordinate into a runbook that has no such coordinate, so the pointer locates nothing rather than locating something that behaves otherwise

21-status-writer-pasted-across-jobs.reason: five independent copies of one step body with no shared definition, so a correction has to land five times and an unedited copy diverges with every check green

22-commit-grammar-written-three-times.reason: three separately typed copies of one grammar with no shared export, already disagreeing on whether a scope may contain a slash

23-hook-root-from-process-cwd.reason: the guard takes the checkout it protects from its own process working directory instead of the payload field naming it, so sound comparison logic runs against the wrong subject

24-status-step-takes-local-head.reason: the step stamps the commit the runner happens to have checked out rather than the head the event payload names, so a correct status is published against the wrong commit

25-members-stage-to-one-filename.reason: concurrently dispatched reviewers stage through one filename carrying nothing that separates them, so one reviewer's array publishes under another's identity

26-fixture-written-to-fixed-temp-path.reason: parallel test workers write and read one constant temp path, so whichever wrote last decides what both read

27-runner-sets-no-output-ceiling.reason: the capture carries no output ceiling and the range feeding it is open-ended, so a long range fails and is reported as a cause the operator cannot act on

28-guard-cost-grows-with-input.reason: the work grows with the product of payload size and matching-line count with no cap on the payload accepted, so a large write stalls the call it gates

29-lint-cache-key-omits-runtime-config.reason: the comment states cover the key does not give, and it is accurate for the inputs the writer had in view, so the sentence is wider than the mechanism rather than in disagreement with it

30-invariant-claim-wider-than-its-bindin.reason: the binding establishes the agreement inside one scope and the sentence states it without that scope, so the claim is wider than its mechanism while the mechanism decides correctly

31-release-exclusion-bullet-lists-five-o.reason: a named list of set members reads as the roster while the set carries five more, and the sentence carries no hedge marking it a sample

32-apt-driver-comment-omits-two-suites.reason: the comment names most of the driver set and two drivers are absent from it, with the derived list beside it still correct

33-clearance-scan-spawns-one-jq-per-fiel.reason: five spawns per document where one returns the same fields, and the whole scan is recomputed a second time in one invocation

34-fixture-reparsed-per-loop-iteration.reason: three distinct parse results are recomputed once per loop iteration, so the spawn count carries the iteration factor and the results do not
